{{Short description|none}}
The '''2025 Copa Libertadores qualifying stages''' were played from 4 February to 13 March 2025.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/calendario-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-y-conmebol-sudamericana-2025/|title=Protegido: Calendario de la CONMEBOL Libertadores y CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2025|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=18 September 2024|access-date=1 November 2024|language=es}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.lavoz.com.ar/deportes/futbol/conmebol-publico-el-calendario-2025-cuando-arranca-la-copa-libertadores-para-talleres/|title=Conmebol publicó el calendario 2025: cuándo arranca la Copa Libertadores para Talleres|trans-title=Conmebol published the 2025 calendar: when does the Copa Libertadores start for Talleres?|publisher=[[La Voz del Interior]]|date=13 December 2024|access-date=15 December 2024|language=es}}</ref> A total of 19 teams competed in the qualifying stages to decide four of the 32 places in the [[2025 Copa Libertadores group stage|group stage]] of the [[2025 Copa Libertadores]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/Manual-de-Clubes-CL-2025-ESP-Digital.pdf|title=Manual de Clubes CONMEBOL Libertadores 2025|trans-title=2025 CONMEBOL Libertadores Clubs Handbook|publisher=CONMEBOL|language=es|date=12 December 2024|access-date=16 December 2024}}</ref>

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the qualifying stages was held on 19 December 2024, 12:00 [[Time in Paraguay|PYT]] ([[UTC−03:00|UTC−3]]), at the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.lanacion.com.ar/deportes/futbol/cuando-es-el-sorteo-de-la-copa-libertadores-2025-nid16122024/|title=Cuándo es el sorteo de la Copa Libertadores 2025|trans-title=When is the draw for the 2025 Copa Libertadores|publisher=[[La Nación]]|language=es|date=16 December 2024|access-date=17 December 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/los-cruces-en-la-fase-preliminar-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-2025/|title=Los cruces en la Fase Preliminar de la CONMEBOL Libertadores 2025|trans-title=The Preliminary Stage matchups of the 2025 CONMEBOL Libertadores|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=19 December 2024|access-date=20 December 2024|language=es}}</ref>

Teams were seeded by their ''CONMEBOL Clubs ranking'' as of 16 December 2024 (shown in parentheses),<ref name="ranking">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/Ranking-CONMEBOL-2025-Final-2.pdf|title=Ranking de Clubes de la CONMEBOL 2025|trans-title=2025 CONMEBOL Clubs Ranking|publisher=CONMEBOL|language=es|date=16 December 2024|access-date=16 December 2024}}</ref> taking into account the following three factors:<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/sistema_de_puntaje_ranking_de_clubes_2021.pdf|title=RANKING DE CLUBES DE LA CONMEBOL 2021 SISTEMA DE PUNTAJE|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=2 February 2021|language=es|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210830090237/https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/sistema_de_puntaje_ranking_de_clubes_2021.pdf|archive-date=30 August 2021}}</ref>
#Performance in the last 10 years, taking into account Copa Libertadores and Copa Sudamericana results in the period 2015–2024.
#Historical coefficient, taking into account Copa Libertadores and Copa Sudamericana results in the period 1960–2014 and 2002–2014 respectively.
#Local tournament champion, with bonus points awarded to domestic league champions of the last 10 years.

For the first stage, the six teams were drawn into three ties (E1–E3), with the teams from Pot 1 hosting the second leg.<ref name="draw procedure">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/pautas-de-sorteo-para-la-conmebol-libertadores-y-conmebol-sudamericana-2025/|title=Pautas de sorteo para la CONMEBOL Libertadores y CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2025|trans-title=Draw guidelines for the 2025 CONMEBOL Libertadores and CONMEBOL Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL|language=es|date=10 December 2024|access-date=16 December 2024}}</ref>

For the second stage, the 16 teams were drawn into eight ties (C1–C8), with the teams from Pot 1 hosting the second leg. Teams from the same association could not be drawn into the same tie, excluding the three winners of the first stage, which were seeded in Pot 2 and whose identity was not known at the time of the draw, and could be drawn into the same tie with another team from the same association.<ref name="draw procedure"/>

For the third stage, the eight winners of the second stage were allocated without any draw into the following four ties (G1–G4), with the team in each tie with the higher CONMEBOL ranking hosting the second leg.<ref name="draw procedure"/>

*Second stage winner C1 vs. Second stage winner C8
*Second stage winner C2 vs. Second stage winner C7
*Second stage winner C3 vs. Second stage winner C6
*Second stage winner C4 vs. Second stage winner C5<section end=Draw />

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
In the qualifying stages, each tie was played on a home-and-away [[two-legged tie|two-legged]] basis. If tied on aggregate, [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] was not played, and a [[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] was used to determine the winner (Regulations Article 2.4.3).<ref name="regulations"/><section end=Format />

==Bracket==
<section begin=Bracket />
The qualifying stages are structured as follows:
*'''First stage (6 teams):''' The three winners of the first stage advance to the second stage to join the 13 teams which are given byes to the second stage.
*'''Second stage (16 teams):''' The eight winners of the second stage advance to the third stage.
*'''Third stage (8 teams):''' The four winners of the third stage advance to the group stage to join the 28 direct entrants. The four teams eliminated in the third stage enter the Copa Sudamericana group stage.<section end=Bracket />
The bracket was decided based on the first stage draw and second stage draw, which was held on 19 December 2024.

==Second stage==
===Summary===

==Third stage==
